title: A place's social pages are searched as from its country, and a city Google names in another script than the place's name stays out of the query and the locality match
steps: S1: read Kirami Sushi Bar's Google Place Details as fetched on dev (city and emirate in Arabic, neighbourhood Al Barari and country AE in Latin) into the search's place; also a Japanese name with a Japanese city.
S2: match the Kirami Facebook page as ScrapeCreators read it (address naming Al Barari and Dubai, the branch phone).
S3: search Kirami's Facebook page through a provider that records each query and what it was asked.
S4: call ScrapeCreators, Jina, Firecrawl and SerpApi search with a country, then without one.
S5: list the web-search providers an operator can order.
expect: S1: Kirami has no locality, localities [Al Barari] and country AE; the Japanese place keeps its Japanese city.
S2: confirmed on the branch phone.
S3: one query, 'Kirami Sushi Bar facebook', asked with {country: 'AE'}; the page is confirmed.
S4: ScrapeCreators region=AE, Jina and SerpApi gl=ae, Firecrawl country ae; none of them sent without a country.
fence: searchPlaceOf's sameScript locality and country, localityOf over localities, findSocialPages passing {country} to each searcher, the country parameter of each web search client

tests: searchPlaceOf: a city in another script than the name is left out; the Latin areas and the country stay
searchPlaceOf: a name and city in the same non-Latin script keep the city
match: a page naming one of the Latin areas (the neighbourhood) matches the locality
find: every search carries the place's country, and no query carries a city in another script
scrapeCreatorsGoogleSearch: a country becomes the region parameter
each adapter searches as from the place's country when given one, and as before without
